data.name: Startup_Error_Message
data.value: Something went wrong while starting Lumen. Details were written to the log in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Lumen\logs.

data.name: Library_Empty
data.value: No games yet. Lumen finds the games installed with your stores (Steam, Epic, GOG, Ubisoft, EA, Battle.net, Xbox) by itself; you can also add any game or app with Add, or by dragging an .exe, a shortcut or a link here.

data.name: Library_ScanProblems
data.value: Some items from {0} could not be read. Details are in the log.

data.name: Library_ScanFailed
data.value: The library could not be scanned. Details are in the log.

data.name: Settings_Steam_Description
data.value: Add your Steam Web API key and SteamID64 to also see the games you own but haven't installed. The key is encrypted on this PC and is only sent to Steam.

data.name: Settings_Steam_SteamIdHint
data.value: The 17-digit number in steamcommunity.com/profiles/…. If your profile has a custom URL, you can find the number in Steam → Account details.

data.name: Settings_Steam_KeySavedHint
data.value: A key is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.

data.name: Settings_Steam_Private
data.value: Connected, but your game details are private, so Steam lists no games. In Steam, open your profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings and set Game details to Public.

data.name: Settings_Steam_InvalidKey
data.value: Steam rejected this key. Check it on the Steam API key page.

data.name: Settings_Steam_Unreachable
data.value: Couldn't reach Steam. Check your connection and try again.

data.name: Settings_Steam_InvalidSteamId
data.value: Enter a SteamID64 (17 digits starting with 7656119) or a steamcommunity.com/profiles/… URL.

data.name: Settings_Steam_MissingKey
data.value: Enter your Steam Web API key.

data.name: Settings_Steam_InvalidKeyFormat
data.value: That doesn't look like a Steam Web API key (32 letters and numbers).

data.name: Settings_Steam_Removed
data.value: Steam account details removed from this PC.

data.name: Settings_Steam_KeyHint
data.value: When Steam asks for a domain name, any name works (for example localhost): Lumen doesn't use it.

data.name: Manual_RemoveConfirm
data.value: Remove "{0}" from Lumen? The file itself is not touched.

data.name: Manual_SaveFailed
data.value: The item could not be saved. Details are in the log.

data.name: Manual_Error_TitleTooLong
data.value: The name can have up to 120 characters.

data.name: Manual_Error_TargetMissing
data.value: Choose a file or enter a web address.

data.name: Manual_Error_UnsupportedFileType
data.value: Only .exe, .lnk and .url files can be added.

data.name: Manual_Error_RelativePath
data.value: Use the full path, for example C:\Games\game.exe.

data.name: Manual_Error_UnsupportedUrl
data.value: This kind of address isn't allowed, for your safety.

data.name: Manual_Error_ArgumentsTooLong
data.value: Launch arguments can have up to 2000 characters.

data.name: Manual_Error_ArgumentsNotAllowed
data.value: Launch arguments only work with .exe files.

data.name: Settings_Library_MergeDescription
data.value: A game you own on several stores shows up once, and Play uses the store where it's installed. If you showed stores separately, merged items by hand or picked a store for a game, you can go back to automatic grouping here. Custom names and hidden items are kept.

data.name: Settings_Library_ResetDone
data.value: Grouping was reset: games are grouped automatically again.

data.name: Artwork_InvalidImage
data.value: That file isn't a JPG, PNG or WebP image (or it's larger than 10 MB).

data.name: Settings_Artwork_Description
data.value: Steam games get their covers from Steam automatically. Add a free SteamGridDB API key to also get covers for games from other stores and manual items. The key is encrypted on this PC and only sent to SteamGridDB.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_KeySaved
data.value: A key is saved. Paste a new one to replace it.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_Connected
data.value: Connected. Covers for your other games will load as you browse the library.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_InvalidKey
data.value: SteamGridDB rejected this key. Check it on your SteamGridDB profile.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_InvalidKeyFormat
data.value: Paste the key from your SteamGridDB profile (letters and numbers only).

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_Unreachable
data.value: Couldn't reach SteamGridDB. Check your connection and try again.

data.name: Settings_Sgdb_Removed
data.value: SteamGridDB key removed from this PC. Covers already downloaded stay.

data.name: Settings_Artwork_CacheCleared
data.value: Artwork cache cleared. Covers will download again as you browse; custom covers were kept.

data.name: Library_NoMatches
data.value: Nothing matches your search and filters.

data.name: Detail_RenameHint
data.value: Only Lumen uses this name; the store keeps its own. Leave it empty to use the store's name ({0}).

data.name: Detail_HiddenBanner
data.value: This item is hidden: it only shows with the “Hidden” button in the library.

data.name: Detail_MergeHint
data.value: For the same game on two stores that Lumen didn't match. Search for the other one and pick it; it will show up once, with both stores. You can undo it with “Show stores separately”.

data.name: Detail_MergeTypeToSearch
data.value: Type part of the name to search.

data.name: Detail_UninstallStore
data.value: {0} will ask you to confirm. Lumen updates by itself when it's done.

data.name: Detail_UninstallStoreLibrary
data.value: The {0} library is open: find “{1}”, open its menu (⋯) and choose Uninstall. Lumen updates by itself when it's done.

data.name: Detail_UninstallWindows
data.value: Windows Settings → Apps is open: search for “{0}”, open its menu (⋯) and choose Uninstall. Lumen updates when you come back.

data.name: Detail_UninstallFailed
data.value: Couldn't open {0} to uninstall. Uninstall it from {0} directly.

data.name: Home_NoGames
data.value: No installed games yet. Install one from your stores or add one in the Library, and it will show up here.

data.name: Home_NoHistory
data.value: The games you play show up here.

data.name: FirstRun_Welcome_Body
data.value: All your games, from every store, in one place. First, choose your language.

data.name: FirstRun_Stores_Body
data.value: Lumen reads what each store saves on this PC. It never changes anything in them and doesn't need your passwords.

data.name: FirstRun_Stores_Hint
data.value: Missing a store? Install it, then use “Rescan” in the Library.

data.name: FirstRun_Keys_Title
data.value: Optional: more games and better artwork

data.name: FirstRun_Keys_Body
data.value: A Steam key also shows the Steam games you own but haven't installed. A SteamGridDB key finds covers for games from other stores. Keys are stored encrypted on this PC and are never shared. You can also do this later in Settings.

data.name: FirstRun_Done_Body
data.value: Your library is in Lumen. Everything in this welcome can be changed later in Settings.

data.name: Discover_Body
data.value: Apps installed on this PC that aren't in your library yet. Add the ones you want at hand; ignored ones won't be suggested again. Lumen only reads the Start menu: it changes nothing.

data.name: Discover_IgnoredNotice
data.value: “{0}” won't be suggested again. You can bring it back from “Ignored”.

data.name: Discover_SaveFailed
data.value: Couldn't save that choice. Try again.

data.name: Discover_AllReviewed
data.value: No new apps to suggest. Apps you install later will show up here.

data.name: Collections_Body
data.value: Group games and apps your way. Favorites also show on Home. Add items from a game's detail view (More → Collections) or the star.

data.name: Collections_DeleteConfirm
data.value: Delete the collection “{0}”? The games and apps in it stay in your library.

data.name: Collections_SaveFailed
data.value: Couldn't save that change to your collections. Try again.

data.name: Detail_NoCollections
data.value: You have no collections yet. Create one here.

data.name: SteamFamily_Unreachable
data.value: Couldn't reach Steam. Check your connection and try again.

data.name: EpicAccount_Description
data.value: Show the Epic games you own but haven't installed. You sign in on Epic's own page in your browser: Lumen never sees your password. Optional: installed Epic games show up without it.

data.name: EpicAccount_Steps
data.value: 1. Sign in on the Epic page that just opened in your browser. 2. Epic then shows a short text with "authorizationCode". Copy the code (or the whole text). 3. Paste it below and choose Connect. The code works once and only for a few minutes.

data.name: EpicAccount_Connected
data.value: Connected. Your Epic games are being added to the library.

data.name: EpicAccount_NotACode
data.value: That doesn't look like Epic's code. Copy the authorizationCode value (32 letters and numbers) or the whole text Epic shows.

data.name: EpicAccount_CodeRejected
data.value: Epic didn't accept that code. Codes work once and expire after a few minutes: sign in again to get a new one.

data.name: EpicAccount_ActionRequired
data.value: Epic needs you to do something on its website first (for example accept new terms). Sign in at epicgames.com, then try again.

data.name: EpicAccount_Failed
data.value: Couldn't connect to Epic. Try again in a moment.

data.name: EpicAccount_WhatLumenCanDo
data.value: Lumen can only read the list of games you own on Epic. It can't buy anything, change your account or see your password. The sign-in is stored encrypted on this PC and is only used with Epic. Disconnect removes it.

data.name: EpicAccount_DisconnectConfirm
data.value: Disconnect your Epic account? Games you own but haven't installed will leave your library, and Lumen will end its session at Epic.

data.name: EpicAccount_Disconnected
data.value: Disconnected. Epic ended Lumen's session and it was deleted from this PC.

data.name: EpicAccount_DisconnectedLocally
data.value: Deleted from this PC, but Epic didn't confirm ending the session. It expires by itself; you can also sign out of all sessions in your Epic account settings.

data.name: GogAccount_Description
data.value: Show the GOG games you own but haven't installed. You sign in on GOG's own page in your browser: Lumen never sees your password. Optional: installed GOG games show up without it.

data.name: GogAccount_Steps
data.value: 1. Sign in on the GOG page that just opened in your browser. 2. When you're in, the page may look blank: copy the whole address from the browser's address bar (it starts with embed.gog.com/on_login_success). 3. Paste it below and choose Connect. It works once and only for a few minutes.

data.name: GogAccount_Connected
data.value: Connected. Your GOG games are being added to the library.

data.name: GogAccount_NotACode
data.value: That doesn't look like GOG's address. Copy the whole address from the browser after signing in (it contains "code=").

data.name: GogAccount_CodeRejected
data.value: GOG didn't accept that code. It works once and expires after a few minutes: sign in again to get a new one.

data.name: GogAccount_Failed
data.value: Couldn't connect to GOG. Try again in a moment.

data.name: GogAccount_WhatLumenCanDo
data.value: Lumen can only read the list of games you own on GOG. It can't buy anything, change your account or see your password. The sign-in is stored encrypted on this PC and is only used with GOG. GOG offers no way to cancel it from outside: Disconnect deletes it from this PC, and it expires by itself.

data.name: GogAccount_DisconnectConfirm
data.value: Disconnect your GOG account? Games you own but haven't installed will leave your library, and the sign-in will be deleted from this PC.

data.name: GogAccount_Disconnected
data.value: Disconnected. The sign-in was deleted from this PC.

data.name: Settings_CloseToTray
data.value: Keep Lumen in the notification area when I close the window

data.name: Settings_StartWithWindows
data.value: Start Lumen with Windows (in the notification area)

data.name: Tray_Hint_Message
data.value: It's in the notification area. To close it completely, right-click its icon and choose Exit Lumen. You can change this in Settings.

data.name: QuickSearch_Hint
data.value: Type to search your games and apps.

data.name: Settings_Hotkey_Description
data.value: Opens a search box over any app. Type, then press Enter to play.

data.name: Settings_Hotkey_Invalid
data.value: Use Ctrl, Alt or Win together with a letter, a number, an F key or Space.

data.name: Settings_Hotkey_Taken
data.value: Another app is using {0}, so it doesn't work right now. Choose a different one.

data.name: SteamWeb_Description
data.value: Shows the games your Steam family shares with you. You sign in on Steam's own website, inside Lumen, like in any browser.

data.name: SteamWeb_HowItWorks
data.value: A window with Steam's real sign-in page opens: scan the QR with the Steam app or use your account there. Lumen doesn't see what you type and doesn't pretend to be any other app or device.

data.name: SteamWeb_WhatLumenDoes
data.value: Lumen only reads your list of games and the ones your family shares. The session stays in Lumen's own browser on this PC, protected by your Windows account. Lumen never buys, changes settings or reads anything else. Disconnect signs out on Steam and deletes that browser's data.

data.name: SteamWeb_Disconnected
data.value: Signed out on Steam, and the browser's data was deleted.

data.name: SteamWeb_DisconnectedLocally
data.value: The browser's data was deleted here, but Steam didn't confirm the sign-out. If you want, end the session in Steam → Settings → Security.

data.name: SteamWeb_NeedsReconnect
data.value: Steam no longer accepts this sign-in (it expired or was ended elsewhere). Sign in again to see family games.

data.name: SteamWeb_Ready
data.value: Done. Your library now includes your own Steam games and the ones your family shares.

data.name: Routine_Body
data.value: A routine does several things with one click: open games, apps, web pages and folders, wait, or close programs. Routines never run scripts or commands.

data.name: Routine_Empty
data.value: No routines yet. Create one with “New routine”, or import a .json file.

data.name: Routine_Result_Changed
data.value: The file changed since you approved it: review it again.

data.name: Routine_Problem_Blocked
data.value: it's not allowed (see Lumen's safety rules).

data.name: Routine_Problem_NotInLibrary
data.value: it's not in your library on this PC.

data.name: Routine_Problem_NotFound
data.value: the program or folder wasn't found.

data.name: Routine_Problem_Url
data.value: Write an address that starts with http:// or https://.

data.name: Routine_Problem_Wait
data.value: Write a number of seconds from 0 to 300.

data.name: Routine_Problem_ProcessName
data.value: Write a program name like discord.exe.

data.name: Routine_Problem_TooMany
data.value: A routine can have up to {0} steps.

data.name: Routine_Review_Hint
data.value: This routine is new or was changed outside Lumen. Check every step; it only runs after you approve it.

data.name: Routine_Review_TrustedHint
data.value: You already approved this routine. These are its steps.

data.name: Routine_Review_BlockedHint
data.value: This routine has a step Lumen never runs, so it can't be approved. You can edit it and remove that step.

data.name: Routine_Note_OutsideLibrary
data.value: Not in your library: check it's the program you expect

data.name: Routine_Note_Closes
data.value: Closes programs (asks them to close first)

data.name: Routine_Note_ForcesClose
data.value: Closes programs, and ends them if they don't close (unsaved work is lost)

data.name: Routine_Note_NotInLibrary
data.value: Not in your library on this PC

data.name: Routine_Blocked_NotAbsolute
data.value: Blocked: it needs a full path like C:\Games\game.exe

data.name: Routine_Blocked_NotAProgram
data.value: Blocked: only programs (.exe) can be opened, never scripts or shortcuts

data.name: Routine_Blocked_ScriptHost
data.value: Blocked: command lines, scripts and system tools are never run

data.name: Routine_Blocked_ShortName
data.value: Blocked: short names with ~ aren't allowed

data.name: Routine_Blocked_ProtectedProcess
data.value: Blocked: Windows' own programs and Lumen are never closed

data.name: Routine_Blocked_NotAWebPage
data.value: Blocked: only http:// and https:// pages

data.name: Routine_Editor_NoSteps
data.value: No steps yet. Add the first one below.

data.name: Routine_Editor_SearchLibrary
data.value: Search your library and pick a result

data.name: Routine_Editor_Force
data.value: End it if it doesn't close (unsaved work is lost)

data.name: Routine_Editor_StopOnError
data.value: Stop at the first step that fails

data.name: Routine_DeleteConfirm
data.value: Delete “{0}”? This removes the routine file; nothing else is touched.

data.name: Routine_UndoStillOpen
data.value: Asked to close, but {0} program(s) are still open ({1}). Some games ignore the request or just minimize.

data.name: Routine_ForceConfirm
data.value: End {0} now? Anything not saved in it is lost.

data.name: Routine_ForceFailed
data.value: Windows didn't let Lumen close it. Close it from the program itself or Task Manager.
